title: Case: Shipment is approaching its return-to-sender deadline
context: The parcel’s return timer is nearing its cutoff. The carrier permits a new collection arrangement if the verified recipient chooses before that cutoff.
initial_request: No recipient choice is recorded. Please contact authorised recipient Nalo Vere now, before the cutoff, rather than let the return timer expire.

events.body: DL-9780 will enter return-to-sender processing at 16:00 UTC today unless a customer selects redelivery on 2027-02-19 or depot collection on 2027-02-19. Both options are currently available.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-018: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. photo-evidence-867.txt is mentioned but missing from the case; the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. label-scan-497.txt belongs to another shipment (DL-36743); the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
